lessons.trigger_condition: FX collection can renew an old quote, legacy grade profiles lack sale evidence, and UTC lifecycle guards can disagree with Korean business dates; EUR helper dependency was not explicitly packaged.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use the older actual FX observation and file clock; auto-fill only exact completed-sale prices with valid recent source dates; share a KST lifecycle date and require the imported EUR module in runtime packaging.
validation_required: Deterministic UI declarations and stale observation/price evidence cases
KST midnight boundary collector/publish agreement and missing EUR dependency rejection
Exact source/proof/candidate ancestry plus immutable historical successor checks
lessons.safety_boundary: Preserve calibration, historical proofs, main protection, device-local learning ledgers and separate physical readback; no invented prices, grades, deployment or device result.
